scope: Read-only exploratory retrospective census. Fixed entire completed 16-start Immortal Domination Slinger cohort; no outcome selection or treatment-effect claim.
primary_selection: For each stem/target choose lowest continuation ordinal containing an actual decision at frame 0; then first such recorded decision. Retain all other same-frame decisions and continuation candidates as controls. Missing exact targets stay missing.
plots: Every distinct complete captured read of the selected decision must end at the selected target/frame0. Replace plots on explicit tiles records; do not merge absent keys or stamp metadata-only tiles_delta as a plot read. Only explicit plots with observed turn equal to target qualify as current.
unknowns: Retain missing/ambiguous/incomplete/nonfinite/negative sentinel readings; never replace missing with zero or a neighboring turn. Rival city/population decomposition only when the actual all-major leader has met-rival public stats at the same state.
